title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。
summaryEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」與「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" and "Column overlap mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改良體滲流」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treated-ground seepage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改良體滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses. Low average permeability therefore does not prove a sealed curtain; acceptance must address both material properties and geometry. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treated-ground seepage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「改良體滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treated-ground seepage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。
knowledge.textEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。
改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。
每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
optionsEn: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength.
Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
quiz.explanation: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改良體滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Treated-ground seepage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
optionsEn: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改良體滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Treated-ground seepage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification"?
options: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改良體滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Treated-ground seepage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。
每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff.
Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
quiz.explanation: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱體交疊」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱體交疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity. Clay lumps, gravel and layering can create noncircular sections, requiring trial columns and full-depth evidence to define conservative geometry. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱體交疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Column overlap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。
optionsEn: Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability.
quiz.explanation: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱體交疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column overlap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Column overlap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱體交疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。
knowledge.textEn: Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Column overlap mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。
平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head.
Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱體交疊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Column overlap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。
knowledge.textEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column overlap mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for.
quiz.explanation: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
